**24 tests fail and 1 errors, out of 487 (462 pass, 1 skipped).** Almost all of them come from one root cause: the installed Werkzeug is older than Tessel requires.

## Main root cause: Werkzeug 3.0.3 installed, Tessel needs >=3.1.0 (20 of the 24 failures, plus the 1 error)
- `pyproject.toml:29` requires `werkzeug>=3.1.0`, but the environment has 3.0.3.
- `src/tessel/sessions.py:374` (`persist_session`) calls `response.set_cookie(..., partitioned=partitioned, ...)`. That keyword was added in Werkzeug 3.1, so it raises `TypeError: Response.set_cookie() got an unexpected keyword argument 'partitioned'`.
- This happens on any response that writes a session cookie, so every test that touches the session fails:
  - **`test_basic.py` (13):** `test_session_accessed`, `_path`, `_using_application_root`, `_using_session_settings`, `_using_samesite_attribute`, `_secret_key_fallbacks`, `_expiration`, `_stored_last`, `_special_types`, `_cookie_setting`, `_vary_cookie`, `_refresh_vary`, and `test_extended_flashing`.
  - **`test_helpers.py` (1):** `TestStreaming::test_stream_keeps_session`.
  - **`test_reqctx.py` (2):** `test_copy_context_thread`, and `test_session_dynamic_cookie_name`. The latter fails on `assert b'<!doctype h...' == b'value set'` because the 500 error page comes back instead.
  - **`test_signals.py` (1):** `test_flash_signal`.
  - **`test_templating.py` (1):** `test_standard_context`.
  - **`test_testing.py` (3):** `test_redirect_session`, `test_session_transactions`, `test_session_transaction_ipv6`.
- The teardown **error** is the same cause. In `test_stream_keeps_session` the `TypeError` leaves an `AppContext` leaked, so the `assert not leaks` check at `tests/conftest.py:79` fails.

## Separate cause 2: also Werkzeug version (1 failure)
- `tests/test_request.py::test_limit_config` asserts `r.max_form_memory_size == 500_000` but gets `None`. This attribute is also new in Werkzeug 3.1, so the older Request class doesn't support it.

## Separate cause 3: missing optional dependency (1 failure)
- `tests/test_helpers.py::TestStreaming::test_async_view` fails with `RuntimeError: Install Tessel with the 'async' extra in order to use async views.` (`src/tessel/app.py:1096`).
- `asgiref` isn't installed (`import asgiref` raises `ModuleNotFoundError`).

## Not fully explained (1 failure)
- `tests/test_helpers.py::test_open_resource_exceptions[a]` failed in my first full run, but it passes when run in isolation and I couldn't reproduce it afterwards. I couldn't capture its traceback.
- It is probably collateral from the leaked context in `test_stream_keeps_session`, but I haven't confirmed that.
- My attempt to re-run the full suite three times to check was blocked by a permission denial, so I stopped there.

## Fix direction (not applied)
Installing the declared dependencies (`werkzeug>=3.1.0` and `asgiref` for the async extra) should clear causes 1–3. Nothing has been changed.
